## Workload

Hannah Lowe completed 535 reads during the review period, recording 261 hours of work. This represents a rate of 2.0 reads per hour. The workload record provides a clear summary of the activity completed by the grader and supports comparison between the total reads and the hours recorded.

The current session pattern was considered alongside this workload information. On the information available, the grader and reviewer agreed to keep the current session pattern.

## Quality

A sample of 48 reads was checked again as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 43.8. This result is documented for ongoing monitoring and provides the quality measure associated with the reviewed sample.

The review was completed by Priya Anand, who considered the checked reads and the recorded agreement. Hannah Lowe remains identified as the grader for this review.
